param.label: Optional structure dataset
param.help: Use __INPUT_STRUCTURE__ in the JSON/YAML specification to reference this copied Galaxy dataset.

param.name: contig
param.label: Contig
param.help: RFD3 contig expression for the designed chain/region.

param.name: ckpt_path
param.label: Checkpoint path
param.help: Leave blank to use the checkpoint configured in the Foundry environment.

param.name: additional_overrides
param.label: Additional RFD3 CLI overrides
param.help: Space-separated Foundry overrides, for example num_timesteps=30 step_scale=1.5.

tool.help:
This wrapper runs the Foundry ``rfd3 design`` command and collects generated ``CIF``/``PDB`` structures into Galaxy datasets while preserving the complete RFD3 output directory as a ZIP archive.
For maximum coverage, use **Raw RFD3 input specification** and provide the same JSON/YAML ``inputs`` file you would pass to the official CLI. If that file needs to reference a Galaxy-uploaded structure, put ``__INPUT_STRUCTURE__`` in the specification and supply the structure dataset in the optional structure field.
The scenario forms cover common documented workflows: de novo length design, protein binder design, nucleic-acid binder design, small-molecule binder design, and enzyme/motif-conditioned design. Advanced parameters are passed as Foundry CLI overrides.
